claims.source_quote: As unfavorable cavity geometry is taxing to dentin bond integrity in root canals, a strategy that relies on increasing the frictional resistance to post dislodgement via delayed hygroscopic expansion of glass-ionomer based materials may be a more pragmatic approach to fiber post retention.
claims.note: The claim preserves the possible contribution of water-related hygroscopic expansion to frictional post retention; the source’s statement explicitly connects expansion and frictional resistance.
